text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one cent bug was discovered in billing/invoice_totals.py in the totals calculator on 2026-03-07.","The root cause of the bug was missing Unicode normalisation before hashing.","The fix implemented normalisation to NFC (Normalization Form C) before computing the digest.","The bug manifested as a one cent gap appearing in reconciliation reports.","The fix was submitted as PR #2342 on the branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1.","The bug could be reproduced by totaling an invoice with three prorated lines.","Prior to the fix, a related flaky test was failing approximately 58 times per hundred runs.","After the fix was applied, the flaky test began passing consistently with zero failures."]}
